description: This file defines the JoinedDate class, which is a filter field used in reporting within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterField class and implements logic to add date-based conditions to database queries based on specified operators (less than, greater than, between). It leverages traits for date/time helpers and interacts with an ORM's query builder to construct SQL expressions for filtering employees by their joining date.

classes.name: JoinedDate
classes.description: A filter class for applying date range conditions on employee's joined date within report queries.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds conditional expressions to the query builder based on the operator and date values for filtering employees by their joined date.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, in this case, ['employee'].
